_comment: The Seica Israel design system, as embodied in assets/rfq_template.docx.
The template IS the design system's output, so generated rows inherit their
styling by being cloned from it - nothing here needs to be applied for an
offer to look right. These values are recorded so the palette is readable
without opening Word, and so scripts/apply_theme.py can re-assert them over
'placeholder' is load-bearing rather than decorative: the design writes
unfilled values in that slate and real content in the default near-black,
so build_rfq.py drops it from anything it fills in.
Colours are Word-style RRGGBB hex with no leading '#'.
